timeout_ms.description: Foreground duration before the command automatically becomes a background job. Default: 120000 (2 minutes)

async.description: Start as a daemon-managed background job immediately

action.description: open requires scheme, host, and path; screenshot and snapshot take action alone; eval requires code; click requires selector XOR both x and y; type requires text and optionally selector/clear; select requires selector and value; scroll requires selector or delta_y; wait requires wait_for, with selector for selector waits and url_substring for url waits.

clear.description: type only; optionally clear a selector-targeted control before setting text. Null for every other action and focused typing.

code.description: eval only; required UTF-8 JavaScript, at most 16384 bytes. Null for every other action.

delta_y.description: scroll only; required for window scrolling and ignored in selector mode. Null for every other action.

host.description: open only; required for open. Hostname or literal IP only; no credentials or URL delimiters. Null for every other action.

path.description: open only; required and fixed to the origin root. Paths are excluded so capability and signed URL material is never journaled. Null for every other action.

port.description: open only; optional port. Null for every other action.

scheme.description: open only; required for open and null for every other action.

selector.description: CSS selector, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Required for select and selector waits; optional selector mode for click/type/scroll. Null for actions that do not target elements.

text.description: type only; required UTF-8 text, at most 16384 bytes. Null for every other action.

timeout_ms.description: wait only; optional bounded deadline in milliseconds (1..=20000, default 10000). Null for every other action.

url_substring.description: wait kind=url only; required URL substring, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Match-only material that is never echoed in results. Null for every other wait kind and action.

value.description: select only; required option value, at most 1024 UTF-8 bytes. Null for every other action.

wait_for.description: wait only; required wait kind. selector requires selector; url requires url_substring; navigation/load take neither.

x.description: click only; viewport CSS-pixel x coordinate. Requires y and excludes selector. Null for every other action.

y.description: click only; viewport CSS-pixel y coordinate. Requires x and excludes selector. Null for every other action.

include_done.description: Include completed/canceled issues in the board snapshot. Default false.

issue.description: Issue identifier (e.g. ABC-123) for a single-card deep view: full description, acceptance criteria, relations, last 5 comments, bound run.

project.description: Project name, project ID, or Linear project URL. Omit to list active projects (id, name, state, teams) instead of a board.

comment.description: Markdown comment to post on the issue.

description_replace.description: Full description replacement. Prefer the section-level fields; this clobbers any human edits.

state.description: Workflow state name. Completed/canceled states are rejected.

verification_criteria.description: Replaces the `## Acceptance criteria` section of the card body.

blocked.description: ref or identifier of the issue that cannot start yet.

blocking.description: ref or identifier of the issue that must finish first.

execution.description: afk = a worker can take this card to a merged diff unattended; hitl = needs human decisions mid-flight. Default afk.

extra_sections.description: Additional card sections (e.g. "What NOT to do", "Prior context to read first") appended verbatim in order.

identifier.description: Existing issue (e.g. ABC-123) to update; omit to create.

project.description: Short stable repo name from the project registry / mission attachment set.

labels.description: Label names; found or created on the team.

milestone.description: Project-milestone name (e.g. "M1: Developer Beta"); found or created in the project.

parent_ref.description: ref or identifier of the parent (milestone/master) card.

ref.description: Local handle (e.g. "t1") that edges/parent_ref in this same call may reference before Linear ids exist.

state.description: Workflow state name. Defaults to the team's backlog state on create. Completed/canceled states are rejected.

verification_criteria.description: Observable acceptance criteria (a test, command, or user-visible behavior a worker can actually check). These become the spawned worker's verification contract verbatim.

what_to_build.description: 1-3 sentences of end-to-end demoable behavior. Rendered as `## What to build`.

why.description: Motivation paragraph. Rendered as `## Why this exists`.

id.description: Existing project id or name to update; omit to create a new project.

team.description: Team key (e.g. ENG). Required when creating.

summary.description: 1-3 sentences describing this board mutation; shown at the top of the user's approval prompt.

model.description: Optional per-node model override. Beats the role's configured model. This spawn runs on its pre-assigned route (a reviewer's configured reviewer route) — leave the pair unset unless you must deliberately override that route, and then use an exact pair from `list_available_models`.

nickname.description: Optional human-friendly nickname for progress events.

project.description: Optional attached repo this subagent pins to — a path or repo name from the mission's attachment set. Omit to target the primary repo. Unknown values refuse the spawn and list the valid attachments.

provider.description: Optional per-node provider override, paired with `model`. Beats the role's configured provider. Gateway providers ('openrouter', 'baseten', 'fireworks') route OpenAI-compatible models: bip resolves endpoints and credentials in code — name the provider, never an endpoint or key. This spawn runs on its pre-assigned route (a reviewer's configured reviewer route) — leave the pair unset unless you must deliberately override that route, and then use an exact pair from `list_available_models`.

reviews_thread_id.description: The completed worker node this reviewer reviews, copied exactly from that worker result's `data.child_thread_id` (ABC-456: a review references its executor's result by id; it never re-derives the unit). bip provisions the reviewer a throwaway worktree with that unit's diff applied; the reviewer's own writes are never merged.

task.description: Task or question for the subagent to handle.

thinking_effort.description: Optional per-node thinking-effort override. Raise it for deep-judgment nodes; leave it low for mechanical ones.

linear_issue.description: Linear issue identifier (e.g. ABC-123) this node implements. bip fetches the card and builds the worker's brief from it (What to build + Acceptance criteria), refuses the spawn if the card is blocked by unfinished cards, flips the card to In Progress, and posts run-started / result comments automatically. When set, `task` becomes optional extra guidance appended to the card brief.

model.description: Per-node model, exactly as `list_available_models` returned it. Beats the role's configured model. Required on this spawn: use an exact pair from `list_available_models`. Omitting the provider/model would silently run the node on the coordinator's own frontier model at frontier prices.

nickname.description: Optional human-friendly nickname for progress events.

project.description: Optional attached repo this subagent pins to — a path or repo name from the mission's attachment set. Omit to target the primary repo. Unknown values refuse the spawn and list the valid attachments.

provider.description: Per-node provider, paired with `model` exactly as `list_available_models` returned it. Beats the role's configured provider. Gateway providers ('openrouter', 'baseten', 'fireworks') route OpenAI-compatible models: bip resolves endpoints and credentials in code — name the provider, never an endpoint or key. Required on this spawn: use an exact pair from `list_available_models`. Omitting the provider/model would silently run the node on the coordinator's own frontier model at frontier prices.

task.description: Task or question for the subagent to handle. Optional when `linear_issue` is set (becomes extra guidance appended to the card brief); required otherwise.

thinking_effort.description: Optional per-node thinking-effort override. Raise it for deep-judgment nodes; leave it low for mechanical ones.

unit.description: Typed unit-of-work contract (M2). MANDATORY — the runtime refuses a coordinator's read-write spawn without one.

deliverable.description: The exact artifact: files created/changed, answer shape, or branch state.

depends_on.description: Unit ids that must be COMPLETE AND MERGED first. Naming a same-wave unit is refused — dependencies mean 'previous wave'.

envelope.description: Declared effort envelope (NOT a hard cap); feeds the watchdog escalation ladder.

id.description: Tree-unique unit id (e.g. "U3"). Duplicates are refused.

inputs.description: Everything a FRESH agent needs: paths, prior unit ids whose results are prerequisites, doc URLs.

objective.description: One imperative sentence (1-300 chars): what done means, not how.

owns.description: Ownership globs. Same-wave units must own DISJOINT paths (validated at admission).

verify.description: ONE command that proves the unit done. Mandatory for read-write units; bip runs it in the worker's worktree.

cwd.description: Optional, relative to the unit's worktree root.

timeout_secs.description: Optional; default 600s. If verification isn't cheap, the unit is too big.
